name: audentic-website
description: Install and troubleshoot an existing published audentic voice agent on a React or HTML website.

interface.longDescription: Add an existing published audentic voice agent to your website. Get React Client Component or HTML embed code, adapt it to your site's conventions, diagnose allowed-origin and microphone problems, and check the integration. In a coding environment, the skill can edit your website and run its usual checks; in chat, it provides code and setup instructions. You supply a published agent ID and allow the website's exact origin in audentic. This plugin does not create or manage agents, access your audentic account, start voice calls, or process payments.
defaultPrompt: Add my published audentic voice agent to this React website.
Give me HTML embed code for my published audentic agent.
Help diagnose why my audentic widget cannot connect on my website.

publication.release_notes: Updated React 0.7.0 examples, typed-input and conversation-recovery guidance, starting-language setup, mobile checks, and the OpenAI voice-agent guide. Plugin and standalone skill downloads are documented in the coding-agent guide. No account management or MCP server is included.
